name: io.github.rwestergren/rachio-mcp
description: MCP server for Rachio sprinkler controllers — schedules, zones, and live watering control

environmentVariables.name: RACHIO_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Long-lived Rachio OAuth access token. Mint one with `rachio-mcp-token` (or `uvx --from rachio-mcp rachio-mcp-token`). The token lasts ~25 years and replaces sending your password to the MCP process.
